answer: A fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. Each applicant locks a 40-unit deposit and publishes a fingerprint of past work; verifiers check it over a long horizon, so a new fake has no history to show. The ledger mirrors each agent's activity, exposing copied fingerprints. Consistent agents reach the summit tier and unlock deposits after 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 units, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
